# Forma

> Forma is a web gym operating system for Egyptian operators: members, QR check-in, sales CRM, WhatsApp-ready follow-ups, coaching, and billing. Sales-assisted onboarding, plans in EGP, paid by bank transfer.

Forma is gym management software at https://www.forma-official.com. Staff use the web app at https://app.forma-official.com. The full brief is [llms-full.txt](https://www.forma-official.com/llms-full.txt).

## Product

- [Home](https://www.forma-official.com/): Gym management software in Egypt
- [Home (Arabic)](https://www.forma-official.com/ar): فورما — برنامج إدارة الجيم في مصر
- [Why Forma](https://www.forma-official.com/why-forma): Gym-native platform, not a multi-industry ERP template
- [Plans](https://www.forma-official.com/plans): Basic, Gold, and Platinum in EGP
- [Technology](https://www.forma-official.com/technology): React, Vite, Node.js, Express, MongoDB, Cloudflare R2
- [FAQ](https://www.forma-official.com/faq): Onboarding, payment, plans, staff login, and stack
- [Gym management software in Egypt](https://www.forma-official.com/gym-management-software-egypt): Egypt positioning
- [WhatsApp gym CRM](https://www.forma-official.com/whatsapp-gym-crm): Shared sales pipeline with WhatsApp-ready follow-ups
- [Multi-branch gym software](https://www.forma-official.com/multi-branch-gym-software): More than one location
- [Get started](https://www.forma-official.com/get-started): Open a gym workspace
- [Technology (Arabic)](https://www.forma-official.com/ar/technology): التقنية
- [FAQ (Arabic)](https://www.forma-official.com/ar/faq): الأسئلة الشائعة
